en: I HAVE A QUESTION FOR EVERYONE.
What's the matter?
THERE IS SOMETHING I CANNOT{SAUT}UNDERSTAND IN REGARDS TO{SAUT}YOUR ACTIONS.{PAGE}WHY DO YOU RECOGNIZE AIGIS-SAN{SAUT}AS AN "INDIVIDUAL"?
Why...?
AIGIS-SAN IS A ROBOT. SHE IS NOT{SAUT}AN ORGANIC BEING, LIKE THE REST{SAUT}OF YOU.
That's an easy one...{PAGE}It's because she's our companion.{SAUT}No other reason besides that.
YOUR COMPANION...?

When it comes to recognizing somebody{SAUT}as one of our own, it doesn't matter{SAUT}whether they're organic or inorganic.{PAGE}We fight together and push forward{SAUT}together. Those reasons are more{SAUT}than enough for us.
BUT, MY "COMPANIONS" RECOGNIZE{SAUT}ME AS AN ERROR. THEY WILL NOT{SAUT}HELP ME.
Hey, Ribbon-chan―how would you{SAUT}describe a "companion"?
I RECOGNIZE THE TERM AS DEFINING{SAUT}THOSE WITH THE SAME APPEARANCE,{SAUT}ABILITIES, AND LACK OF ERRORS.
Your use of that word... "Error"... I can't{SAUT}explain why, but I sure don't like it.
THEN, A DISQUALIFICATION, OR{SAUT}A DEFECTIVE―
None of that either!
Man, all those words sound like the shit{SAUT}some high'n'mighty asshole would say.{PAGE}It's bullshit how they're forcing these{SAUT}selfish rules on the whole society!
BUT, RULES ARE MEANT TO BE{SAUT}FOLLOWED...
You don't have to follow them.{OPTION}You're not an error, Ribbon.
I AM... NOT AN ERROR?
Say, Ribbon. Why don't you try going{SAUT}along with our own beliefs while you're{SAUT}with us?
That sounds like a great idea.{PAGE}You don't have to keep following some{SAUT}self-centered Overseer's nonsense!
Mmhm. And if those bots try something{SAUT}again, we'll protect you with everything{SAUT}we got!
YOU'LL PROTECT ME? BUT, WHY HELP{SAUT}A UNIT SUCH AS MYSELF?
*giggle* Remember what we said{SAUT}earlier? The answer to this one's{SAUT}simple, too...{PAGE}It's because you're just as much{SAUT}of a companion to us as Aigis,{SAUT}Ribbon-chan.
I... AM A COMPANION?{PAGE}......{PAGE}SO, THIS IS WHAT BEING{SAUT}A COMPANION IS LIKE...{SAUT}I COMPREHEND.
I comprehend.
Heheh, their speech patterns are{SAUT}syncing up.
I'm sorry. I could not help myself.
*giggle* Oh, Aigis...{PAGE}Well then, let's start over. Are you ready{SAUT}to go, Ribbon-chan?
YES. I AM YOUR COMPANION. I SHALL{SAUT}PROCEED ONWARD WITH YOU!
Heh, that's the spirit. Keep it up.
Then, shall we get back on track? I hope{SAUT}we can stick together, Ribbon.
